# Receipt-verifier fixtures

Recorded `EXPERIMENTAL_tx_status` responses (`wait_until: FINAL`) used by
`tests/receipt_fixtures.rs` and `tests/provider_rpc.rs`. The tests are
offline: they parse these files, they never call a node.

Every file has the same envelope: `_fixture` (provenance and the expected
verifier outcome) and `response` (the JSON-RPC response).

## Real capture

| File | Source |
|---|---|
| `mainnet_direct_ft_transfer.json` | Mainnet tx `ZonAdEjgAUM4tBnCR3nJTxe9LHiv7KcsbqRZdp9dns1` (signer `hlpok1lad.tg`, native USDC to `gateway.hlpok1lad.tg`, memo `aps2_2160_6ad8a68a_00001`), read-only call on 2026-11-04. The regular mainnet RPC had already garbage-collected it (`TIMEOUT_ERROR`, cause `NOT_OBSERVED`), so `https://archival-rpc.mainnet.near.org` served it. Public chain data. |

## Synthetic fixtures

Each `synthetic_*.json` file carries `"synthetic": true` and is generated by
`generate_synthetic.py` (stdlib only):

```sh
python crates/near-adapter/tests/fixtures/generate_synthetic.py crates/near-adapter/tests/fixtures
```

They mirror the real capture's structure (transaction, transaction
outcome, receipt outcomes with executor, status, logs and child receipts,
and receipt bodies with predecessor and actions). Account ids end in
`.fixture.testnet` and receipt ids start with `Synth`, so none can be
mistaken for chain data. The placeholder memo `aps2_fixture_00001` is
replaced by a real intent id when a test drives a provider.

| File | Case | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| `synthetic_wallet_pay.json` | policy-wallet `pay` (predecessor = wallet) | Confirmed, payer = wallet |
| `synthetic_failed_transfer.json` | direct transfer panics in the token | Failed |
| `synthetic_wallet_pay_transfer_failed.json` | token receipt fails after logging, callback succeeds | Failed, failed receipt's logs ignored |
| `synthetic_not_final.json` | reported at `EXECUTED_OPTIMISTIC` | NotFinalYet |
| `synthetic_spoofed_event.json` | non-token contract logs a perfect event | StructuralMismatch |
| `synthetic_spoofed_event_with_dust.json` | fake event plus a real 1-unit transfer with another memo | StructuralMismatch |
| `synthetic_ft_transfer_call_refund.json` | `ft_transfer_call` to a plain account, refunded | StructuralMismatch |
| `synthetic_wrong_memo.json` | another intent's memo | StructuralMismatch |
| `synthetic_wrong_amount.json` | 2000000 where 1000000 is due | Confirmed amount, reconciliation Mismatch, orphan |
| `synthetic_wrong_recipient.json` | memo matches, recipient is another account | StructuralMismatch |
| `synthetic_two_matching_transfers.json` | two token receipts pay the same intent | Confirmed by the first, second is an orphan |
| `synthetic_one_receipt_two_events.json` | one receipt with two matching events | StructuralMismatch, both orphans |
| `synthetic_batch_storage_and_transfer.json` | `storage_deposit` + `ft_transfer` batch | Confirmed |
| `synthetic_top_level_success_receipt_id.json` | top-level `SuccessReceiptId` | StructuralMismatch (malformed) |
